    <div class="headline">UCI Basic Needs: CalFresh Analysis</div>

    <div class="project-meta-block">
      <p class="project-meta-line">Independent Project</p>
      <p class="project-meta-line">01/2026-03/2026</p>
    </div>

    <p class="body-text"><strong>Project Context:</strong> I previously worked as a Program Coordinator at UCI's Basic Needs Center, where I helped manage the center's CalFresh Assistance Appointment and CalFresh Enrollment Party data. During my MSBA program, I came back to that same data and rebuilt it as an interactive dashboard the team could actually use to track performance over time.</p>

    <p class="body-text"><strong>Business Question:</strong> <em>How is the UCI Basic Needs Center's CalFresh assistance program performing over time, and what operational changes would most improve student access and staff efficiency?</em></p>

    <a class="dashboard-mobile-link" href="https://public.tableau.com/views/CFAssistanceOverview-UCIBasicNeedsCenter/Overview2" target="_blank">Open Interactive Dashboard &rarr;</a>

    </div>

    <div class="tableau-breakout">
      <div class="tableau-wrap">
        <div class='tableauPlaceholder' id='viz1788383797706' style='position: relative'><noscript><a href='#'><img alt=' ' src='https://public.tableau.com/static/images/CF/CFAssistanceOverview-UCIBasicNeedsCenter/Overview2/1_rss.png' style='border: none' /></a></noscript><object class='tableauViz' style='display:none;'><param name='host_url' value='https%3A%2F%2Fpublic.tableau.com%2F' /><param name='embed_code_version' value='3' /><param name='site_root' value='' /><param name='name' value='CFAssistanceOverview-UCIBasicNeedsCenter/Overview2' /><param name='tabs' value='yes' /><param name='toolbar' value='yes' /><param name='static_image' value='https://public.tableau.com/static/images/CF/CFAssistanceOverview-UCIBasicNeedsCenter/Overview2/1.png' /><param name='animate_transition' value='yes' /><param name='display_static_image' value='yes' /><param name='display_spinner' value='yes' /><param name='display_overlay' value='yes' /><param name='display_count' value='yes' /><param name='language' value='en-US' /></object></div>

    <div class="content-inner">

    <div class="tabs">
      <button class="tab-btn active" onclick="showTab('findings-recs', this)">Findings &amp; Recommendations</button>
      <button class="tab-btn" onclick="showTab('methodology-takeaways', this)">Methodology &amp; Takeaways</button>
    </div>

    <!-- FINDINGS & RECOMMENDATIONS -->
    <div id="findings-recs" class="tab-panel active">

      <div class="rec-card high">
        <div class="rec-priority">High Priority</div>
        <div class="rec-title">Overhaul the Intake Form</div>
        <div class="rec-desc">The Acuity intake form wasn't built for analysis, especially its overlapping student eligibility questions, which made every export painful to clean. A redesigned form with cleaner dropdowns, plus one added field capturing which eligibility a student actually used, would fix this at the source instead of in Excel every time.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="rec-card med">
        <div class="rec-priority">Medium Priority</div>
        <div class="rec-title">Build SAR7 and Recertification Outreach</div>
        <div class="rec-desc">CalFresh requires a SAR7 check-in at 6 months and a full Recertification (RE) at 12, and students who miss either lose their benefits. Proactive reminders tied to these deadlines, personalized once the form captures which eligibility a student actually applied under, would help more students stay enrolled instead of lapsing.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="rec-card med">
        <div class="rec-priority">Medium Priority</div>
        <div class="rec-title">Lean Into Enrollment Party's Growth</div>
        <div class="rec-desc">EP events have grown from 84 to 572 students a year and now outpace individual appointments. As EP keeps scaling, shifting some of its operational and tabling support to the outreach team would free advocates to focus on the one-on-one casework only they can do.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="rec-card low">
        <div class="rec-priority">Lower Priority</div>
        <div class="rec-title">Reframe Eligibility as an Awareness Problem</div>
        <div class="rec-desc">94% of students served already qualify for CalFresh, most through LPIE, UCI majors and programs pre-approved for automatic eligibility. Eligibility isn't the barrier anymore, awareness is, so outreach should focus on telling more students they already qualify rather than convincing them they might.</div>
      </div>

      <div class="rec-card low">
        <div class="rec-priority">Lower Priority</div>
        <div class="rec-title">Test Better No-Show Reminders</div>
        <div class="rec-desc">No-show rates have stayed flat for years despite generic email reminders. SMS reminders and a short personal note introducing the advocate a student will meet are both worth testing before assuming the problem can't move.</div>
      </div>

    </div>

    <!-- METHODOLOGY & TAKEAWAYS -->
    <div id="methodology-takeaways" class="tab-panel">

      <div class="section-heading" style="margin-top:0.25rem;">Methodology</div>
      <ul class="findings-list">
        <li><strong>Data source:</strong> 6,261 CalFresh Assistance Appointment records (Jan 2022-Feb 2026) exported from Acuity Scheduling, the system the Basic Needs Center uses to book these one-on-one sessions.</li>
        <li><strong>Data cleaning:</strong> done entirely in Excel, including text-to-columns parsing, manual dummy variables for eligibility, and reconciling a form that changed structure multiple times over the years.</li>
        <li><strong>Dashboard build:</strong> built in Tableau Desktop and published to Tableau Public, covering completed appointments, eligibility rates, advocate workload, and SAR7/RE trends over time.</li>
      </ul>

      <div class="section-heading">Takeaways</div>
      <ul class="findings-list">
        <li>Data cleaning wasn't a preliminary step, it was most of the work. A form that changed shape year over year meant almost every column needed a second look before a chart could go up.</li>
        <li>Coming back with new tools to a place I already knew changed what I built. I already knew which questions mattered to the team, so the dashboard could skip straight to what they'd actually use.</li>
        <li>The dashboard mattered less than the recommendations it made possible. The real value was translating patterns into specific, doable changes for a non-technical team.</li>
      </ul>

    </div>

<script>
function showTab(id, btn) {
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-panel').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
  document.querySelectorAll('.tab-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
  document.getElementById(id).classList.add('active');
  btn.classList.add('active');
}
</script>
